criterion_fired: Criterion 2 (Carry-forward consistency) and Criterion 4 (actionable next steps)
suggested_change: For Criterion 4, clarify that 'actionable next step' must specify: (1) who will be contacted, (2) what concrete outcome is required (e.g., meeting scheduled, stakeholder identified, document delivered), and (3) explicit success criteria—not open-ended discovery questions. Example: '[Contact: David] Schedule 15-min call with budget-approval stakeholder to present business case and document evaluation criteria' vs. 'Ask David if he discussed with leadership.'
